scope: Only GMMK3HEDeviceHandler. No installed sources, hardware configuration, or firmware changed.

Keep cached profile and active profile consistent
Skip keys absent from physical layout
Fail when HE write handle is absent

reset_paths_audited: resetAllProperties and _resetAllProperties already replace their cache and active renderer profile together at completion.
limits: No hardware acknowledgement or settings readback is added. Negative transport results now surface as failures.
Existing zero-return semantics are retained because the native API return contract is not established.
A mid-sequence write failure can leave partial device state. No automatic hardware rollback is attempted.
concurrency: Actuation packets explicitly target a profile and layer. Commit merges only that layer HEProperties into the latest profile without changing active profile or layer.
